comments.content: The top-level `web` configuration block is not consumed by the project configuration schema. `OrchestratorConfig` has `server` but no `web` field, and serde ignores unknown fields by default, so these checked-in web monitoring settings are silently ignored rather than configuring cflx.
comments.thinking: src/config/types.rs defines OrchestratorConfig without a web field, while the only refresh_interval_secs support is in src/web/mod.rs WebConfig rather than project config deserialization.
